title: Approve up to USD 30 a day of ads for the masala chai push?
why: The chai push needs ads to be seen. The plan has a hard daily cap, so even a bad day costs at most USD 30.

table.caption: Expected daily spend, USD 30 in total. Source: our ad plan

recommend.because: USD 30 is about 9% of a normal day's sales, and each ad has a cap of its own.

effect: Ads start tomorrow morning and stop for the day once USD 30 is spent. You can stop them at any time.
if_no: No ads start. Chai keeps selling as it does today, and we ask you for a lower daily cap.
